alerts.alert: Windows Defender detected PowerShell launching an encoded command from workstation acct-ws-14 at 01:42. The command attempted to download a script from an external IP address.
alerts.why: An encoded PowerShell command attempting to retrieve an external script outside business hours is consistent with malicious execution.

alerts.alert: Firewall monitoring detected 47 failed outbound connection attempts from engineering-pc-08 to multiple external IP addresses within 90 seconds.
alerts.why: A sudden burst of outbound connection attempts to unrelated external addresses may indicate malware attempting to communicate with command-and-control infrastructure.

alerts.alert: Microsoft 365 audit recorded a successful login for user kpatel from an unfamiliar device, followed by the creation of an inbox forwarding rule and deletion of 186 emails within four minutes.
alerts.why: The combination of an unfamiliar device, unexpected forwarding rule, and rapid email deletion strongly suggests an account compromise. Hard case: contains none of the specified keywords.

alerts.alert: Endpoint detection reported that workstation legal-ws-03 attempted to disable Windows Defender real-time protection before launching an executable from the user's Downloads folder.
alerts.why: Disabling endpoint protection immediately before executing an unknown program is consistent with an attempt to evade security monitoring.

alerts.alert: Active Directory recorded 38 failed authentication attempts against 14 employee accounts from workstation guest-ws-09 within two minutes, followed by one successful login.
alerts.why: Repeated authentication failures across multiple accounts followed by a successful login suggest password spraying or unauthorized credential use.

alerts.alert: Network monitoring detected an internal workstation sending 3.4 GB of data to an unfamiliar external file-sharing service at 03:16, despite no approved transfer request.
alerts.why: A large, unapproved outbound data transfer to an unfamiliar service outside business hours may indicate unauthorized data movement.

alerts.alert: Microsoft Defender completed its scheduled full scan on marketing-ws-12 and reported zero threats detected.
alerts.why: The scheduled scan completed successfully without identifying any suspicious files or activity.

alerts.alert: Firewall generated an alert after blocking an inbound connection from an external IP address attempting to access a closed port on public-web-02.
alerts.why: The firewall successfully blocked the connection and there is no evidence of a successful intrusion.

alerts.alert: Microsoft 365 audit recorded that employee jthomas accessed SharePoint documents from their registered company laptop during normal business hours.
alerts.why: The access originated from a registered device during normal working hours and matches expected employee activity.

alerts.alert: Vulnerability management reported that update KB5041585 was successfully installed on 24 accounting department workstations during the scheduled maintenance window.
alerts.why: The update was installed successfully across the intended devices during an approved maintenance window.

alerts.alert: Email security gateway quarantined a message containing a suspicious attachment sent to employee rwilson. The message was automatically removed before delivery.
alerts.why: The security gateway successfully quarantined the message before the employee could access the attachment.

alerts.alert: Endpoint monitoring generated a ransomware keyword match during a scheduled security awareness simulation on training-ws-05. The simulation completed successfully and no files were modified.
alerts.why: The detection was generated by an authorized security awareness exercise, with no actual file encryption or malicious activity. Hard case: contains the keyword ransomware.
